sections.label: Earlier debate on both Bills
sections.summary: The speaker had explained the amendments in both Bills, and Members already raised questions and views during the earlier debate.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: In that debate, I had explained the amendments proposed in both Bills.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: Members have already raised their questions and expressed their views on both Bills during the earlier debate, although they are still welcome to do so now if there are any.
